description:
What changed in AI today, who gained power, and who is exposed tomorrow?

Alex, Jamie, and Rufus debate the biggest artificial intelligence news from the last 24–48 hours, with three distinct stories, competing perspectives and practical takeaways.

What we covered:
• AP reports tech CEOs and AI rivals increasingly call for safety standards while Washington resists rapid new rules
• Reuters reports Meta’s Mark Zuckerberg said AI labs already have enough incentive to build safely
• ByteDance completes $290 million fundraising for its AI drug unit
• Tech CEOs call for AI regulation. Trump and Congress are not rushing to act
• AP reports Microsoft agreed to AI privacy protections for students in U.S. schools

What changed. Who wins. What you do next.

The Edge: what changed, who wins, who is exposed, and what to watch next.
